china-1924-5:p0508_1.rationale: Import tariff schedule of duty rates per unit for miscellaneous articles (musk, sea-horse teeth, sinews); a tariff-rate table.

china-1924-5:p0508_2.rationale: Import duty rates on timber of various kinds, per 1,000 sup. ft. or ad valorem; both tariff rules and timber commodity content are substantive.

china-1924-5:p0508_3.rationale: Import duty rates on bamboo canes, rattans and various woods. Bamboo and rattan form a substantial share of the rows; the woods are varied.

china-1924-5:p0509_1.rationale: Import duty rates for charcoal, coal, briquettes, liquid fuel, pitch and tar; a mixed set of articles with no single commodity dominating.

china-1924-5:p0509_2.rationale: Import duty rates on chinaware, enamelled ironware, glass and mirrors; most rows concern glass and ceramic products.

china-1924-5:p0509_3.rationale: Import duty rates on cement, corundum sand and emery products; a mixed set of stone and earth manufactures.

china-1924-5:p0510_1.rationale: Import duty rates for fire bricks, fireclay, flints, sand-paper and tiles; a mixed set of building and abrasive materials.

china-1924-5:p0510_2.rationale: Import duty rates on asbestos products (packing, millboard, sheets, yarn). No dedicated asbestos tag exists in the vocabulary.
review_questions: Should an asbestos tag be proposed?

china-1924-5:p0510_3.rationale: Import duty rates on bags, mats and matting of cotton, hemp, straw, rush and other materials; a mixed set with no dominant commodity.

china-1924-5:p0510_4.rationale: Import duty rates on buttons of metal, porcelain, shell and fancy types; a tariff-rate table.
